shared_elements: relief carving of figures on an architectural stone surface
figure holding an object in the hands
justification: Both depict human figures in elaborate headgear rendered in relief with ornamental surrounds, but that is a generic correspondence: A shows a strict horizontal register scheme with a profile procession of robed men and a horse-drawn chariot on a flat, low, linear relief with clean outlines, while B shows a single frontal figure of dense, deeply undercut, high-relief masks, scrolls and volutes filling every space. The arrangement (ordered bands and profile figures versus one vertical frontal figure smothered in ornament) and the depictive conventions differ almost completely, with no shared specific motif.
